stories.title: Murder investigation launched after body found in van on fire in Prestatyn
stories.summary: North Wales Police have launched a murder investigation after a body was found inside a van reported to be on fire in Prestatyn. stories.title: Road closures and temporary lights across Flintshire this week
stories.summary: Lane closures on the A548 at Deeside Industrial Estate and three-way lights on Chester Road in Broughton are among the roadworks listed across Flintshire this week. stories.title: David Attenborough show Our Story to open at Chester Zoo on 17 October
stories.summary: A 360-degree show narrated by Sir David Attenborough opens at Chester Zoo on 17 October, with tickets from £15 on top of zoo admission. stories.title: Couple married at St Ethelwold’s Church in Shotton in 1966 celebrate 60th wedding anniversary
stories.summary: A couple who married in Shotton after meeting as young police officers have celebrated their 60th wedding anniversary. Val and Richard Bennett were married at St Ethelwold’s Church on 17 September 1966. stories.title: More visible policing and quicker responses wanted, North Wales police commissioner’s survey finds
stories.summary: More visible policing and quicker responses are among the things people in North Wales have asked for in a survey run by Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin’s office.
